findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_liquidations, get_carv, get_wlfi_buyback, get_gold, get_nvidia, get_inflation, create_alert, get_stablecoin_flow, get_agent_room · Private data: get_carv, get_wlfi_buyback, get_gold, get_nvidia, create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_flow, get_stablecoin_net_mint, get_desk_strategies, get_token_hub, get_reg_radar, get_data_pack, get_owl_points, arena_forecast, arena_my_forecasts, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: get_open_interest, get_gold, get_nvidia, create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_flow, post_to_room · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist, get_etf_institutional_verdict, run_scenario.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_liquidations, get_carv, get_wlfi_buyback, get_gold, get_nvidia, get_inflation, create_alert, get_stablecoin_flow, get_agent_room · Private data: get_carv, get_wlfi_buyback, get_gold, get_nvidia, create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_flow, get_stablecoin_net_mint, get_desk_strategies, get_token_hub, get_reg_radar, get_data_pack, get_owl_points, arena_forecast, arena_my_forecasts, arena_leaderboard · Public sink: get_open_interest, get_gold, get_nvidia, create_alert, get_track_record, get_stablecoin_flow, post_to_room · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist, get_etf_institutional_verdict, run_scenario

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
